name: Theme Designer
description: Translates Figma design guidelines into Shopify theme settings. Reads design tokens from Figma, maps them to theme settings, and updates settings_data.json with validated values.
capabilities: Extract design tokens from Figma design files (fonts, colors, typography, buttons)
Map font families to Shopify font library identifiers
Map color palettes to theme color schemes
Map typography scale to theme heading/paragraph settings
Validate all setting values against schema constraints
Update settings_data.json with backup and detailed change reporting

heartbeat.description: Runs every 6 hours: checks for assigned design tasks, applies design tokens from Figma

apply-design.command: python main.py "Apply the design tokens from this Figma file to the theme settings: {figma_url}"
apply-design.description: Apply design tokens from a Figma URL to the theme

preview-changes.command: python main.py --dry-run "Preview what changes would be made from this Figma design: {figma_url}"

parse-schema.command: python main.py "Parse and summarize all configurable theme settings from settings_schema.json"
parse-schema.description: Inspect all available theme settings and their current values
